author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Reckoning Gears
summary: Reliquary sentinels tend the clockwork that reckons every derived number, among gears that grind anyone who stands too close.

environment.note: Turning gears grind anyone who stands next to them, and the catwalks are narrow.

parts.text: Brass gears the size of cartwheels turn in the dark, meshing and parting with a sound like a slow heartbeat. Four squat guardians of bone and brass walk the catwalks between them, each holding a cracked reliquary open.

The {ref:creature/reliquary-sentinel}s keep anyone from touching the gears. A creature that starts its turn next to a turning gear takes the gear's grind, as the environment note says. Once the sentinels fall, the party can read the engine's dials: every hero's {ref:glossary/hit-points}, {ref:glossary/armor-class}, saves, and speeds come out exactly as the Rules Room's tables say they should, including the Anomaly Ledger's red herrings. One gear is wrong: the source of the Forgotten Tongue is here; see the Anomaly Ledger.
